# HubbardASCIIToState

Module: **FTI** · directory: `FTI/src/HubbardModels` · binary: `FTI/src/Programs/HubbardModels/HubbardASCIIToState`

```text
HubbardASCIIToState, version 0.01

Usage: HubbardASCIIToState [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (default value = 4)
    -x, --nbr-sites : number of flux quanta (default value = 20)
    --fermion : use fermionic statistic instead of bosonic statistic
    --boson : use bosonic statistics
    --gutzwiller : use the Gutzwiller projection
    -i, --ascii-state : name of the input ASCII description of the state (should use the same convention than FQHESphereShowBasis output)
    --no-normalization : do not normalize the final state

output options:
    -o, --output-file : use this file name instead of trying to replace .txt extension with .vec or appending .vec extension

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
